jobs.title: Development Engineer
jobs.description:
At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own.

The Development Engineer SDIS (m/f/x) is responsible for the development of the Straumann Dental Implant Systems (SDIS) portfolio within the Straumann Group. The engineer will work in interdisciplinary and cross-functional teams including product developers, product designers, manufacturing, quality, regulatory affairs, pre-clinical operations, clinical operations and the sales organizations. The engineer enables dental professionals to positively impact the lives of their customers and patients. The position is based in Basel-Stadt/Basel-Land, Switzerland, and reports to the Team Lead Product Development Instruments. Travel is required by up to 10%.


• Your responsibilities:

  • Overall technical lead on demanding, cross-functional development projects under consideration of the design control process and risk management
  • Evaluation of technical solutions and performance of feasibility studies
  • Translation of user needs and standards into design
  • Coordination of verification and validation (V&V) activities
  • Coordination of design transfer activities
  • Evaluation of business opportunities that come along with design modifications.
  • Technical Lead in root cause investigations
  • Ensure Design History File (DHF) documentation according to GDP
  • Subject Matter Expert in audits
  • Lead students/trainees
  • Support for portfolio strategy
  • Lead customer interaction


Your • Profile - • Qualifications

Education
• Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, microengineering, bioengineering, materials sciences, or a related field of study; M.Sc. is preferred, an advanced degree may count as working experience.
Experience
• 3-5 years’ experience in a related area such as medical device development or other highly regulated products.
• Advanced experience in product development, manufacturing, and testing.
• Advanced experience with standards and regulations (MDR, FDA, ISO, ASTM).
• Sound knowledge of the design control process.
• Sound knowledge of medical device manufacturing processes (e.g., plastic and/or metal injection molding, machining, post processing).
• Sound knowledge of specific development tools (e.g., statistical analysis, FMEA, analysis of mechanical properties, etc.).
• Sound knowledge of SAP and PLM systems.
• Advanced experience with quality system audits and inspections.
• Advanced experience in operating in a matrixed environment.
Personal Attributes
• Highly team-spirited with a pragmatic, hands-on approach.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong interpersonal skills and customer focus.
• Entrepreneurial mindset to take calculated risks.
• Very good communication skills, both verbally and in writing.
• High personal and professional ethics.
• Embraces Straumann’s Mission and Culture.
• Strong continuous improvement skills.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

jobs.description:
Our Mission


Our company goal is to be the most customer focused and innovative oral care company in the world. At the heart of advancing oral care solutions worldwide, the Global Medical Education team drives the empowerment and education of our internal and external partners to ensure the effective adoption and application of Straumann innovations.

Your Purpose

The Straumann Global Medical Education team is responsible for the successful commercialization of Straumann innovations from a training and education perspective.

This function is vital to facilitate meaningful learning experiences that elevate professional skills, inspire confidence, and ultimately improve patient care outcomes globally.

You play a crucial role in bringing our education programs to life by implementing and managing hands-on experiences for healthcare professionals to nurture confident use of Straumann innovations.

Your Impact

In this role, you enable the end-to-end delivery of impactful learning experiences and exploit your strong analytical and financial modeling capabilities and excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills to manage Straumann’s course materials portfolio.

We seek a highly analytical and results oriented professional with experience in international medical device environments to lead:

  • The end-to-end implementation of new course and demo materials concepts in collaboration with internal product and education management organizations, Straumann Group supply chain, as well as 3rd party vendors.
  • The end-to-end lean management of course & demo materials portfolio in collaboration with regions, key markets and select 3rd party education partners.
  • Strategic cost optimization initiatives for course and demo materials in collaboration with cross-functional teams, i.e. finance, accounting, procurement, supply chain, education and external partners.

Who You’ll Collaborate With:

In this role, the following functions are your main interfaces:

  • Global education, product management, and events teams
  • 3rd Party KOLs and course coordinators
  • Internal service departments, such as:
    • Engineering for course material development
    • Logistics for course materials handling
    • Warehouse for course materials inventory management

Your Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

Financial KPIs

  • Manage and reduce COGS, handling mark-ups, and operational costs for course and demo materials
  • Annual realized savings versus baseline
  • Increased number of courses delivered within existing budgets

Operational KPIs

  • Support forecasting and demand planning
  • Implement hands-on exercise kits
  • Optimize and simplify training model portfolios
  • Increase adoption of alternatives to animal and cadaver models
  • Improve standardization across countries and regions

Your • Qualifications & Experience

  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree in Business Administration, Finance, Operations, or related field
  • 5+ years of experience in dentistry space within international medical device or healthcare organizations
  • Proven track record in cost optimization, lean management, and operational transformation
  • Experience working in global matrix organizations
  • Ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and organizational change
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Competence working with MS Office programs
  • Knowledge of dental implantology and digital clinical workflows are a strong plus.
  • Fluency in English is mandatory. Other languages are an advantage.

Personal Attributes

  • Motivated self-starter
  • Team-spirited, structured, results oriented and pragmatic approach to work
  • Strong communication and listening skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with ability to nurture effective in person or remote working relationship
  • Ability to travel (est. 15%)

Please note that this role is based in Basel and its hybrid working model with 2 remote working days/week


All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

Employment Type: Full Time

Alternative Locations: Switzerland : Basel

Travel Percentage: 0 - 20%

Requisition ID: 21557

- Servizi del servizio interno, quali:

- Ingegneria per lo sviluppo del materiale didattico

- Logistica per la movimentazione dei materiali di corso

- Magazzino per la gestione dell'inventario dei materiali

Indicatori di prestazione chiave (KPI):

KPI finanziari

- Gestire e ridurre i COGS, gestire i margini e i costi operativi per materiali di corso e demo

- Risparmio annuo realizzato rispetto al basale

- Aumento del numero di corsi effettuati nei bilanci esistenti

KPI operativi

- Sostegno alla previsione e alla pianificazione della domanda

- Implementare kit pratici per l'esercizio

- Ottimizzare e semplificare i portafogli dei modelli di formazione

- Aumentare l'adozione di alternative ai modelli animali e cadaveri

- Migliorare la standardizzazione tra paesi e regioni

La tua qualifica ed esperienza

- MBA o equivalente laurea in Amministrazione aziendale, Finanza, Operazioni o campo correlato

- 5+ anni di esperienza nello spazio odontoiatrico all'interno di dispositivi medici internazionali o organizzazioni sanitarie

- Proven track record in ottimizzazione dei costi, gestione snella, e trasformazione operativa

- Esperienza lavorando in organizzazioni a matrice globale

- Capacità di guidare iniziative interfunzionali e cambiamenti organizzativi

- Forte capacità di comunicazione e presentazione

- Competenza con i programmi MS Office

- La conoscenza dell'implantologia dentale e dei flussi di lavoro clinici digitali sono un vantaggio forte.

- La fluidità in inglese è obbligatoria. Altre lingue sono un vantaggio.

Attributi personali

- Autoavviamento motivato

- Team-spirited, strutturato, risultati orientati e pragmatico approccio al lavoro

- Forte capacità di comunicazione e ascolto

- Ottime capacità interpersonali con capacità di alimentare efficaci di persona o rapporti di lavoro a distanza

- Capacità di viaggiare (est. 15%)

jobs.description:
At Straumann Group we’re on an exciting journey of growth, innovation, and impact - driven by our mission to improve oral health and transform millions of lives worldwide. United by purpose, we bring our best selves to work every day, embracing a high-performance, player-learner culture that inspires collaboration, curiosity, and ambition. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to take charge of your own career, harnessing your skills, passion, and enthusiasm for learning to continually grow and progress. Together, we’re not just shaping brighter smiles, we’re unlocking the potential of people everywhere, including our own.

Packaging plays a critical role in ensuring the safety, integrity, and usability of our medical devices throughout the entire product lifecycle. Beyond protecting the product, packaging must comply with global regulatory requirements, enable efficient manufacturing and logistics, support sustainability ambitions, and deliver excellent customer experience.
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Packaging Development Engineer to join our Global Packaging team at Straumann Group Headquarters in Basel.
In this role, you will take ownership of complex packaging development and Life Cycle Management (LCM) initiatives across our global product portfolio. You will lead technical packaging projects from concept through implementation, working closely with colleagues from Research & Development, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Procurement, Marketing, and external suppliers.
As a technical expert, you will contribute to the evolution of our packaging platforms, engineering standards, and development processes while supporting the successful transfer, optimization, and continuous improvement of existing products across our global manufacturing network.
This position offers the opportunity to influence packaging strategy, drive innovation, and shape the future of medical device packaging within Straumann Group. The role reports to the Head of Packaging, LCM SDIS & RDI Academy, is based at the company's headquarters in Basel, Switzerland, and requires moderate international travel.


• Your responsibilities:

  • Lead complex packaging development and Life Cycle Management (LCM) projects, from concept through implementation, for new and existing products.
  • Design innovative, robust, and cost-effective packaging solutions that meet product, manufacturing, regulatory, quality, and customer requirements.
  • Drive technical decisions for complex packaging challenges across multiple product families.

Project & Technical Leadership

  • Manage packaging development projects, including planning, timelines, risk assessment, resource coordination, and stakeholder communication.
  • Lead packaging activities supporting global product transfers, manufacturing site localization, supplier changes, and business continuity initiatives.
  • Plan, coordinate, and evaluate packaging verification and validation activities, including transportation testing, shelf-life studies, sterile barrier validation, and compatibility testing.
  • Conduct feasibility studies, engineering evaluations, and cost analyses to identify optimal packaging solutions balancing quality, compliance, manufacturability, sustainability, and total cost of ownership.


Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Provide technical leadership across global cross-functional teams, partnering with Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Procurement, and Marketing.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and external partners to identify, qualify, and implement innovative packaging materials, technologies, and manufacturing processes.
  • Build strong collaborative relationships with global stakeholders, manufacturing sites, suppliers, and packaging experts across the Straumann Group.


Standards, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Define, improve, and maintain global packaging engineering standards, design guidelines, specifications, and best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize packaging design, materials, manufacturing processes, and environmental performance.
  • Monitor emerging technologies, regulatory developments, sustainability trends, and industry standards, translating them into practical engineering solutions.


Expertise & Knowledge Sharing

  • Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for packaging-related topics during internal and external audits, inspections, and regulatory assessments.
  • Mentor colleagues, share technical expertise, and contribute to the continuous development of packaging engineering capabilities across the organization.


Your • Profile - • Qualifications

Education

• Minimum 3 years of experience in packaging development, medical device development, or another regulated industry.
• Experience leading technical projects in cross-functional and international environments.
• Good knowledge of packaging materials, packaging technologies, manufacturing processes, and packaging test methodologies.
• Knowledge of medical device development processes with a good understanding of product and user workflows.
• Experience in project management with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results within agreed timelines.
• Understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards related to medical device packaging, including ISO, ASTM, ISTA, MDR, FDA, and sustainability requirements.
• Knowledge of sterile packaging systems, sealing technologies, and sterilization processes.
• Experience with sterile barrier system validation and related test methods (e.g., seal strength, dye penetration, bubble emission, visual inspection) is considered an advantage.
• Good understanding of Design Control processes for medical devices.
• Experience applying engineering tools such as risk management, technical drawings, statistical analysis, and material performance evaluation.
• Proven ability to identify opportunities for innovation and implement packaging improvements that enhance product performance, manufacturing efficiency, sustainability, or cost competitiveness

Personal Attributes

• Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Collaborative team player with excellent interpersonal and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to build trusted relationships across functions, cultures, and global organizations.
• Takes ownership, makes sound engineering decisions, and delivers pragmatic solutions.
• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical topics to different audiences.
• Fluent in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an advantage.
• Curious, proactive, and motivated by continuous learning and technical excellence.
• Comfortable working in a dynamic international environment with changing priorities.
• Demonstrates integrity, accountability, and a strong commitment to quality and patient safety.
• Embraces Straumann Group's Mission, Values, and collaborative culture.
• Demonstrates a "Player-Learner" mindset: communicates openly, welcomes feedback, continuously develops expertise, and actively contributes to the success of the team.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

We are looking for an intern to join our Clinical Operations group for 6 months. This internship offers hands-on experience in a professional clinical study management for products in the medical device/dental field.

Straumann is renowned for generating strong clinical evidence to support its product portfolio and bring innovative solutions to the market. Joining the Global Clinical Research team, you will work directly with the Investigator-Initiated Studies (IIS) Program Lead and contribute to the coordination of independent research projects that help advance evidence-based dentistry.

Internship Purpose:
Support the Clinical Research team in coordinating and managing clinical studies related to dental implants and digital dentistry solutions, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements while gaining hands-on experience in clinical operations.

Your main responsibilities:

  • Support clinical studies management (data entry, material shipment coordination, and communication with sites and clinicians).
  • Maintain accurate records within our internal Clinical Trial Management System
  • Ensure consistency and completeness of data across study trackers, files, and internal data bases
  • Support in the preparation of reports, presentations, and progress updates for internal stakeholders.
  • Participate in the feasibility assessment of a clinical initiative in collaboration with different stakeholders

Education/Qualification:

  • Graduate or postgraduate in Life Sciences or equivalent.

  • Interest in medical devices or dentistry
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and solution-oriented mindset, eager to explore new ideas and flexible to adapt as priorities evolve.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication in English.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in the health industry and/or clinical research.
  • Experience with document/trial management systems or databases
  • Familiarity with regulatory standards (GCP, ISO 14155, EU MDR)

Personal Attributes:

  • Collaborative attitude, flexible, agile and proactive
  • Analytical way of working, should have attention to detail and a strong sense of accuracy
  • Strong interpersonal skills (high empathy, active listening, motivated)
  • Strong commitment on achieving results
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, being able to communicate complex technical content / processes to different target audiences

Êtes-vous prêt(e) à libérer votre potentiel ?

Chez Straumann Group, nous vivons une période passionnante de croissance, d’innovation et d’impact, guidée par notre mission d’améliorer la santé bucco-dentaire et de transformer la vie de millions de personnes dans le monde. Unis par une même raison d’être, nous donnons chaque jour le meilleur de nous-mêmes dans une culture de performance et d’apprentissage qui favorise la collaboration, la curiosité et l’ambition. Ici, vous aurez l’opportunité de prendre en main votre parcours professionnel, en développant continuellement vos compétences, votre passion et votre envie d’apprendre. Ensemble, nous ne façonnons pas seulement de plus beaux sourires : nous révélons le potentiel de chacun, y compris le vôtre.

Introduction

Dans ce rôle clé, vous contribuez à la fiabilité et à la qualité des données de référence qui soutiennent les opérations industrielles de Straumann. En tant que Master Data Steward, vous garantissez la cohérence, la conformité et la traçabilité des données tout au long de leur cycle de vie au sein de SAP, MES, PLM et des systèmes associés.

Vous travaillez au cœur des interactions entre la Production, l’Industrialisation, les Méthodes, la Qualité, la Supply Chain, le Contrôle de gestion et l’Informatique afin de garantir que les données reflètent fidèlement les processus métiers et les exigences réglementaires. Votre contribution participe directement à l’efficacité opérationnelle, à la qualité des produits et à l’amélioration continue dans un environnement industriel réglementé.

Votre rôle

Gestion des Master Data

  • Créer, maintenir et faire évoluer les données de référence dans SAP et les systèmes associés (articles, nomenclatures, gammes, postes de travail, données MES, PLM, informations achats et données de planification).
  • Garantir l’exactitude, l’intégrité, la cohérence et la conformité des données tout au long du cycle de vie des produits.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes métiers afin de traduire les besoins opérationnels en données fiables et exploitables.
  • Identifier les écarts ou anomalies, analyser leurs causes et coordonner les actions correctives.
  • Participer aux projets de modification de produits, procédés ou équipements en évaluant les impacts sur les données de référence.
  • Accompagner les activités de phase-out et assurer une désactivation cohérente et traçable des données.
  • Fournir un support aux utilisateurs sur les processus et règles de gestion liés aux Master Data.

Gouvernance et amélioration continue

  • Développer et maintenir les procédures, modes opératoires et workflows associés aux données de référence.
  • Contribuer à la standardisation et à l’optimisation des pratiques de gestion des données.
  • Participer à la modélisation et à l’amélioration des processus métier.
  • Soutenir les initiatives de gouvernance des données et les évolutions de systèmes.
  • Promouvoir les bonnes pratiques de qualité des données auprès des parties prenantes.

Analyse de données et reporting

  • Réaliser des analyses permettant d’évaluer la qualité des référentiels et d’identifier des opportunités d’amélioration.
  • Développer et suivre des indicateurs liés aux Master Data.
  • Contribuer à la création et à l’évolution de tableaux de bord Power BI.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes Data, IT et métiers pour structurer et valoriser les données.
  • Participer à la définition des besoins métiers liés aux outils, workflows et reportings.

• Votre profil

• Exigences essentielles

  • Formation en informatique, systèmes d’information, informatique de gestion, data ou domaine équivalent.
  • Expérience en gestion des Master Data dans un environnement industriel structuré.
  • Bonne connaissance de SAP et des données de production telles que les articles, nomenclatures, gammes de fabrication ou postes de travail.
  • Compréhension des exigences de qualité, de conformité, de traçabilité et de gouvernance des données.
  • Expérience en analyse de données et reporting.
  • Maîtrise avancée d’Excel et bonnes connaissances de Power BI, SQL et DAX.
  • Capacité à documenter des processus, rédiger des procédures et formaliser des règles de gestion.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration avec des interlocuteurs variés.

Atouts appréciés

  • Expérience dans le secteur des dispositifs médicaux ou dans un environnement réglementé.

  • Familiarité avec Snowflake ou d’autres plateformes de données modernes.

Job Purpose

The Senior Growth Lead for Single Tooth Solutions at Straumann is accountable for defining and driving the strategic direction and commercial success of the Straumann Single Tooth Indication area. This role ensures that the indication area delivers sustainable growth through clear business cases, differentiated value propositions, and effective go-to-market (GTM) execution. Within this framework, a key responsibility is the successful commercialization of end-to-end clinical workflows.
The position holder can also contribute or temporarily lead initiatives related to other indications (Fixed Full Arch, Removable Full Arch).

Main Tasks and • Responsibilities

  1. Own the indication growth plan and business case, ensuring alignment with the overall business objectives and portfolio strategy (Business Book).
  2. Ensure alignment on business goals and indication growth plan priorities across IBU, CCS, and regions.
  3. Translate market and customer insights into actionable strategies that strengthen Straumann’s competitive position and long-term success.
  4. Define and execute go-to-market (GTM) strategies, including positioning, messaging, pricing, and channel mix, to increase customer value and NCA.
